goals.objective:
=== Goal ===
Objective: Complete Pilot’s owner-directed full-auto capabilities and safely deploy the verified release to the existing Pilot instance.

Success criteria: Each requested action class—test execution, fork, acceptance, commit, push, deploy, spend, provision and publish—has a real, appropriately scoped and policy-controlled model-facing path, or a specifically identified external integration is confirmed unavailable rather than represented as complete. Fork isolation and concurrency, cancellation, durable recovery and enforceable agent budgets are addressed. The design improvements are integrated. An immutable release is deployed, its identity and health are verified, and backup and rollback evidence is recorded. Full completion requires all requested action paths and deployed verification, not merely a green suite or a policy setting.

Boundaries: Continue from the existing integration worktree and preserve its uncommitted changes; review and integrate the previous work. Include documentation and milestone updates, desktop and phone design refinements, safe runner architecture, tests, and the existing Pilot deployment. Do not change unrelated services, publish private operations records, or use real projects and external effects as test fixtures. Do not push or publish source code unless separately authorized; deployment of Pilot is authorized by this goal.

Constraints: Preserve owner authentication, CSRF, Host/origin protections, secrets, revision checks and recovery guarantees. Keep capabilities opt-in and accurately report their limits; never claim the same-UID shell enforces semantic scopes or is sandboxed. Do not grant the application container host privileges or a Docker socket. Avoid destructive actions and automatic retries of uncertain external effects. Perform deployment only after review, verified encrypted backup and isolated restore, and a viable rollback plan; protect live data and running sessions.


If blocked: Continue independent safe work, document the exact blocker and evidence, and stop to ask the user only when a required external integration, credential, permission or safety decision cannot be resolved without them. Never label or deploy an incomplete implementation as complete.

tasks.title: Audit and preserve the integration baseline
tasks.verificationContract: Inspect existing uncommitted work, milestone and deployment state; identify real capability and security gaps without modifying live data.
tasks.evidence: Inspected integration diff, rollout records and live image/health; preserved binary patch and untracked files under ignored operations/goal-baseline with SHA-256 digests.

tasks.title: Implement safe scoped test execution
tasks.verificationContract: Provide an opt-in model-facing test path with exact-job binding, enforced authorization, cancellation and crash recovery; prove its execution architecture does not grant the app host privileges.

tasks.title: Finish fork isolation, concurrency and recovery
tasks.verificationContract: Test child worktree routing, paused admission, grants, concurrent lifecycle operations, cancellation and restart without cross-workspace effects.

tasks.title: Implement scoped autonomous action adapters
tasks.verificationContract: Implement and test acceptance, exact commit and non-force push plus deploy, spend, provision and publish adapters with per-class policy, exact targets, durable receipts and safe uncertainty handling; report unavailable integrations explicitly.

tasks.title: Enforce agent budgets and truthful capability reporting
tasks.verificationContract: Demonstrate per-agent limits and revocation are enforced on actual calls, including races and restarts; UI and model-facing availability match installed capabilities.

tasks.title: Complete the workspace design refresh and documentation
tasks.verificationContract: Validate the supplied design direction across views, themes, desktop and phone, including accessibility and conflict states; update user guides and milestone status.

tasks.title: Review and validate the complete candidate
tasks.verificationContract: Perform independent security review and full application, browser, docs, disposable integration and recovery checks; resolve findings and record evidence.

tasks.title: Back up, deploy and verify Pilot
tasks.verificationContract: Verify encrypted backup and paused isolated restore, stage an immutable candidate with a compatible rollback, safely promote and verify the running release and access controls without touching unrelated services.

goals.verificationContract: Run application type checks, unit/server tests, build, relevant browser tests and documentation checks; add load-bearing tests for authorization, scope revocation, concurrency, cancellation, interruption, duplicate effects and exact targets. Validate actual end-to-end capabilities using disposable roots and stubbed external services; independently review security-sensitive changes. Before and after promotion verify release identity, readiness where authenticated access is available, health and access-denial checks, and document any missing real-world evidence without claiming it passed.
